description: Which goals and goal documents are invalid, and why. Every platform rejects them at construction, sync and import, so no rule ever sees them; the server answers a goal put with document_invalid. A document has every version's errors (each version with the document's pauses and excused days) plus its own. Error codes are listed alphabetically.
